zune_jpeg.hpp is a C++ port of the zune-jpeg JPEG decoder
(https://github.com/etemesi254/zune-jpeg), version 0.5.12 scalar path.

The port retains the upstream license terms: redistribution and modification
are permitted under the MIT, Apache-2.0, or Zlib license, as stated in the file
header:

    This software is free software;

    You can redistribute it or modify it under terms of the MIT,
    Apache License or Zlib license.
